title: When the CAT wants to play: The role of interaction between CRCK3 and CAT2 in Arabidopsis salt stress tolerance
content: Climate change affects multiple global processes, particularly impacting agriculture and food production. Soil salinization, which severely compromises crop productivity in cultivable areas, is one of the most pressing environmental challenges. The accumulation of salts in the soil diminishes water availability for plants and alters the cellular balance, leading to metabolic and growth issues. The salt stress also increases the reactive oxygen species (ROS) produced in the cell, which causes severe oxidative damage at a molecular level, threatening plant health and survival (Zhou et al. 2024).
